'''Gar Tosh''' was the father of [[Jann Tosh]]. During his childhood, he was friends with the researcher [[Akary Smith]]. He eventually had three children with [[Plena Tosh]], first Jann Tosh, then twin boys, [[Gessle Tosh|Gessle]] and [[Trif Tosh|Trif]]. Apart from Jann, Gar and the rest of his family were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a skimmer accident on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Jann would go to live with Gar's best friend, [[Putch Gundarian]] on the mining world of [[Tyne's Horky]].
